title: Tip, pull and park a full-size compact hand truck
instruction: Using the acquired handle and frame-brace grasps, tip the empty cart and pull it toward the arms to the floor mark centered 150 mm behind the nominal reset axle, then stand and release it.
context: A short equipment-staging segment: reposition a real, empty compact hand truck on its passive wheels, then park and release it. It isolates handling of material-moving equipment; physical construction, rated capacity and workplace productivity are not evaluated.
setup: Original calibrated YAM bases at(0,+/-0.305,0.750)m and original cameras, stand and floor. User-authorized U-shaped robot platform:390x860x60mm,center(-0.125,0,0.7175)m,top0.7475m. Rear bridge220x860mm and two170x240mm mount pads leave a380mm center opening; mounting soles and stand foot are supported. Actual-size Wesco220646:1041.4mm operating height,393.7mm width,444.5mm depth;9lb/4.08233133kg current listing versus7.25lb drawing/catalog. Toe381x317.5mm,wheels127x31.75mm. Empty cart on floorZ=-0.0125m;nominal pre-grasp axle(0.500,0,0.051)m,nose+X,markcenter(0.350,0,0.051)m. Left grasp local(0,+0.009,1.0279)m on handle,right(0,-0.015,0.5621)m on estimated upper brace. TCP advances8/12mm along approach; jaw closing axes are perpendicular to crossbars. Two-second native grasp settling; positions can settle away from nominal. Folding/telescope locked deployed,straps/chocks not engaged. Internal dimensions and component masses are estimates.
scoring: Final score:0.25 for tilt>8degrees and front toe>8mm above floor;0.5 additionally requires each wheel net backward travel>125mm and paired supported backward travel>125mm. Both contacts must have separation<=0.5mm and normal-impulse magnitude>1e-7Ns within4 physics ticks; count signed rotation and translation over those same paired intervals. Supported turns>.8rad and |radius*supportedturn-supportedtravel|<25mm for each wheel;axleX in(.315,.385)m,|Y|<40mm.1.0 additionally requires upright<2degrees,frame speed<10mm/s and angularspeed<2degrees/s,no robot/cart contact>.5s,bothTCPs>120mm from either grasp point,and stable finish1s. Wheel height>20mm above or8mm below nominal,both unsupported>.25s unless upright<2degrees with a qualifying recent nose/toe-rib floor contact,or cart/table/camera/stand contact ends atzero. Net arc check does not exclude all cancelling transient slip.
run_limit: 600 control steps (30 simulated seconds at20Hz); fixed seed0.
reset_notes: Restore the empty floor cart and specified handle/brace grasps. Close to the specified gaps and settle for2s with ordinary joint targets and URDF gravity compensation; motors are unchanged. Wheel joints remain passive. Nothing is consumed; no cart/wheel pose is scripted after reset.
fidelity: 1:1 Wesco 220646 envelope, toe and wheels; current 9 lb conflicts with 7.25 lb drawing/catalog. Axle offset is inferred; internal geometry, masses, inertia and friction are estimated. Folding/telescope fixed deployed; empty cart. User-authorized 390x860 mm U platform. Original robot geometry, motors, bases and calibrated cameras; passive wheels, 480 Hz contacts. Gravity offsets use ordinary robot joint targets. Hardware untested.
scores: Scripted demo:1.0 (424 actions,21.20 simulated seconds);Dream-1 beta:0.0 (517 actions,25.85 simulated seconds). Same environment revision,seed0,600-step limit and default action approvals.
